newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Northumbrian Water ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Northumbrian Water ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's rating agency said on Tuesday it affirmed its A plus long-term and A1 short-term ratings of Northumbrian Water Group Plc.
It said the move followed the announcement of a merger plan involving the issuer's unrated parent group, Lyonnaise des Eaux.
It said the stable long term outlook was also affirmed.

"Any presently foreseeable outcome of the projected merger between Lyonnaise des Eaux and Compagnie de Suez would probably not have a material impact on the credit quality of Northumbrian Water Group," S&P said in a statement.
"Nevertheless, Standard & Poor's will review the details as they emerge, and future developemnt of the plan to restructure the composition of the UK water group's majority owner," S&P said.
